procedure: For every qualification, report the exact tested version, test surface and unresolved gates.
Revalidate Autobuild receipt, user-approved assets, source hash and any revised model before promotion.
Import provider responses through dev2 asr_evidence.py; verify pinned source/audio hashes and explicit timing before review; never treat response JSON as provider-authenticated.
